function validate({values}){if(!Array.isArray(values))throw Error('Invalid sheet response');if(!values.length)return{items:[]};const h=values[0];if(!Array.isArray(h))throw Error('Invalid header');const fields=['Email Address','Name','Submitted On'],idx=fields.map(x=>h.indexOf(x));if(idx.some(x=>x<0)||fields.some(x=>h.filter(y=>y===x).length!==1))throw Error('Required headers are missing or duplicated');const seen=new Set(),items=[];for(const row of values.slice(1)){if(!Array.isArray(row)||row.every(x=>x===null||x===undefined||x===''))continue;const [email,name,time]=idx.map(i=>row[i]);if(typeof email!=='string'||!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(email.trim())||typeof name!=='string'||!name.trim()||typeof time!=='string'||!/^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d(?:\.\d+)?(?:Z|[+-]\d\d:\d\d)$/.test(time)||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(time)))throw Error('Each signup requires an email, name and ISO timestamp with time zone');const m=time.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d\d)-(\d\d)T(\d\d):(\d\d):(\d\d)(?:\.\d+)?(Z|([+-])(\d\d):(\d\d))$/),d=new Date(Date.UTC(+m[1],+m[2]-1,+m[3]));if(d.getUTCFullYear()!==+m[1]||d.getUTCMonth()!==+m[2]-1||d.getUTCDate()!==+m[3]||+m[4]>23||+m[5]>59||+m[6]>59||(m[7]!=='Z'&&(+m[9]>23||+m[10]>59)))throw Error('Invalid signup timestamp');const key=email.trim().toLowerCase();if(seen.has(key))throw Error('Duplicate email in the sheet');seen.add(key);items.push({email:email.trim(),name:name.trim(),timestamp:new Date(time).toISOString()})}return{items}}

return validate({values:$input.first().json.values??[]}).items.map((json,i)=>({json,pairedItem:{item:0}}));
